settings.heading: Our Beginning
settings.text:
Founded by two engineers, our journey began with a shared passion for creativity and high quality craftsmanship. With a combined skillset and background in metallurgy and mechatronics, we have spent years working and learning from many different crafts such as Precision CNC machining, 3D printing and automotive parts manufacturing just to name a few.

Throughout our careers, we noticed a recurring challenge among working professionals: the need for affordable, yet stylish and professional-looking tool storage solutions. With our combined expertise and determination to make a difference, we decided to take action.

In 2023, we founded TOOSA to provide innovative tool storage solutions that cater to the needs of professionals at every level.

settings.heading: Why Believe Us
settings.text:
At TOOSA, we believe a workbench is more than just a piece of furniture—it’s the canvas where your hands bring ideas to life. Whether you’re crafting, repairing, or building, your workbench is a space for creativity, problem-solving, and progress. That’s why we provide solutions that inspire confidence and keep your tools within reach, so you can focus on the art of your craft.

Our mission is simple: to provide high-quality, functional storage solutions that meet the needs of both seasoned professionals and budding enthusiasts alike. We believe that everyone deserves a workspace that inspires creativity and efficiency, without breaking the bank.

We are dedicated to listening to our customers’ needs, continually innovating our products, and ensuring that you have the best solutions at your disposal to achieve your goals.

Thank you for being part of our journey. Together, let’s build a better workspace.

settings.heading: What If Everyone Could Have A Workspace Like This?
settings.text:
We posted one of our units on Facebook Marketplace just to see what would happen.

The response was immediate.

We woke up to more inquiries than we expected, and that was the moment we realized there was a real gap in the market.

Professionals, businesses, mechanics, fabricators, tradespeople, and DIYers were looking for the same thing we were:

High-quality tool storage that doesn't cost a fortune and doesn't lock you into one configuration.

TOOSA launched its first line of products in February 2024 with that idea at the centre of everything we do

settings.heading: Built by people who use tools. Designed around the people who get things done.
settings.intro_text: TOOSA was born from a real workshop problem: finding better tool storage without compromising quality, function or value.
settings.story:
TOOSA didn't start with a business plan

It started with a messy metal fabrication shop that needed to be organized.

When we were renovating our own workspace, we started looking for tool storage that was high quality, functional, and built around the way we actually worked.

What we found was frustrating

The options were either expensive, low quality, or lacked the flexibility we were looking for. Some of the solutions we were quoted were in the $30,000–$40,000 range — for a setup we believed should cost a fraction of that.

So we decided to build our own

We designed tool storage around how we wanted to work: integrated work surfaces, easy-access pegboards, concealed upper storage, and a layout that kept everything organized and within reach.

The result completely transformed our workspace

It was cleaner. More organized. More professional. And, most importantly, we could find our tools when we needed them.

People started asking us where the storage came from.

That got us thinking.
